newsitem.title: ITALY: Alitalia can return to profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia can return to profit in 1997.

text.p: Italian flag carrying airline Alitalia could return to profit in 1997, the company's commercial director Federico Nucci said on Monday.

"The trend so far shows positive figures ahead of forecasts. If we can continue in this actual trend we will not close 1997 at breakeven, but with a significant profit," Nucci said while attending a ceremony in Rome.
Alitalia showed a group net consolidated loss of 1.203 trillion lire in 1996.

In May, Milan financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore said Alitalia was hoping to reach breakeven in 1997 after chalking up losses for a ninth year in a row in 1996. The paper said that an Alitalia report envisaged a 1997 result "before extraordinary components and taxes, of around breakeven".
